title: Dizziness and Fatigue
diagnosis: Duodenal Ulcer with Iron Deficiency Anemia
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} presents with progressive fatigue, dizziness, and dyspnea on exertion. Exam reveals pallor and epigastric tenderness. Labs show iron deficiency anemia. History reveals NSAID use and epigastric pain relieved by food — classic for duodenal ulcer. Duodenal ulcers are more common than gastric ulcers and pain classically improves with meals (food buffers acid). H. pylori testing is essential. Treatment: PPI, H. pylori eradication if positive, discontinue NSAIDs. Iron supplementation for anemia. If alarm symptoms (weight loss, bleeding, early satiety) → endoscopy. Avoid invasive testing in stable patient with classic history.

stacks.label: Physical Exam: Heart / Cardiovascular
stacks.finding: Tachycardia from anemia. Flow murmur possible.

stacks.label: Physical Exam: Rectal
stacks.finding: DRE for melena — rule out GI bleeding.

stacks.label: Iron studies (ferritin, serum iron, TIBC)
stacks.finding: Low ferritin, low iron, high TIBC = iron deficiency anemia.

stacks.label: Occult blood, stool
stacks.finding: Positive — chronic GI blood loss from ulcer.

stacks.label: H. pylori testing (stool antigen / urea breath test / serology)
stacks.finding: Duodenal ulcers strongly associated with H. pylori. Eradication prevents recurrence.

stacks.label: PPI (Omeprazole / Pantoprazole)
stacks.finding: Acid suppression for ulcer healing. 4-8 week course.

stacks.label: H. pylori eradication (triple/quadruple therapy)
stacks.finding: Clarithromycin triple therapy or bismuth quadruple if resistance concern.

decoys.label: EGD before H. pylori testing
decoys.reason_wrong: EGD reserved for alarm symptoms (weight loss, bleeding, >55yo with new dyspepsia). Test for H. pylori and treat empirically in young patients without alarm symptoms.

teach_me_steps.order: Duodenal ulcer: pain RELIEVED by food
teach_me_steps.reasoning: Duodenal ulcer pain improves with meals (food buffers acid). Gastric ulcer pain worsens with meals. IDA from chronic blood loss.
H. pylori eradication prevents recurrence. Triple therapy: PPI + clarithromycin + amoxicillin/metronidazole. PPI for 4-8 weeks.

case_summary: Duodenal ulcer + IDA from chronic blood loss. Epigastric pain relieved by food + FOBT positive + microcytic anemia. H. pylori test → PPI + eradication + iron. Stop NSAIDs.
